digo_source: Mgombato ('tumbaku snuff, tobacco; ugoro'; 'chiko' snuff container/pipe)

teaser.en: A Digo proverb holds that *chiko chaajira ndilo*: a pipe suits an honourable person.
teaser.sw: Methali ya Kidigo inasema *chiko chaajira ndilo*: kiko humfaa mtu mwenye heshima.
teaser.dg: Ndarira ya Chidigo inagomba *chiko chaajira ndilo*: chiko chinamfwaha mutu wa hishima.

summary.en: *Tumbaku* is tobacco, a minor leaf crop on the coast. It is used as snuff and for smoking.
summary.sw: *Tumbaku* ni tumbaku, zao dogo la majani pwani. Hutumika kama ugoro na kwa kuvuta.
summary.dg: *Tumbaku* ni mmea wa makodza unaorimwa chidide pwani. Nkuhumirwa kpwa kunusa na kpwa kuvuta.

about.en: Tobacco is a tall, leafy plant with large, broad, sticky-hairy leaves and clusters of pink or white trumpet-shaped flowers. The leaves are harvested and dried before use.
about.sw: Tumbaku ni mmea mrefu wenye majani mengi, makubwa, mapana yenye vinyweleo vinavyonata, na mashada ya maua ya waridi au meupe yenye umbo la tarumbeta. Majani yake huvunwa na kukaushwa kabla ya kutumika.
about.dg: *Tumbaku* ni mmea mure wenye makodza manji. Makodzage ni makulu na mapana, genye nyere ndide zinazonyata, na maruwage ni ga pinki au mereru, ga umbo ra ndzumari, ganamera kpwa mafungu. Makodza nkunyotolwa na nkuumiswa kabla ya kuhumirwa.

where.en: Tobacco is a minor crop on the south coast.
where.sw: Tumbaku ni zao dogo pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: Dried tobacco is used as snuff and for smoking.
uses.sw: Tumbaku iliyokaushwa hutumika kama ugoro na kwa kuvuta.
uses.dg: *Tumbaku* iriyoumiswa nkuhumirwa kpwa kunusa na kpwa kuvuta.

culture.en: Snuff and the pipe carried respect. The *chiko*, a snuff container or pipe, appears in the proverb *Chiko chaajira ndilo*, 'a pipe suits an honourable person'.
culture.sw: Ugoro na kiko viliheshimiwa. *Chiko*, chombo cha ugoro au kiko, kinatajwa katika methali *Chiko chaajira ndilo*, 'kiko humfaa mtu mwenye heshima'.
culture.dg: Kare, tumbaku ya kunusa na chiko kala ni vitu vya hishima. *Chiko*, chombo cha kuikira tumbaku ya kunusa au chiko cha kuvutira, chinaphahikana kpwenye ndarira *Chiko chaajira ndilo*, 'chiko chinamfwaha mutu wa hishima'.

names.en: The Digo word *tumbaku* means both tobacco and snuff, and is the same as in Swahili, where snuff is also *ugoro*. In English it is tobacco.
names.sw: Neno la Kidigo *tumbaku* lina maana ya tumbaku na pia tumbaku ya kunusa, na ni sawa na la Kiswahili, ambapo tumbaku ya kunusa pia huitwa *ugoro*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *tobacco*.
names.dg: Neno ra Chidigo *tumbaku* rina mana mbiri: mmea wa tumbaku, na tumbaku ya kunusa. Chiswahili piya china dzina *tumbaku*, na kpwa Chiswahili tumbaku ya kunusa piya inaihwa *ugoro*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *tobacco*.

reason.en: Another minor cash crop of the coast
reason.sw: Zao jingine dogo la biashara la pwani
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa biashara unaorimwa chidide pwani

sources: Mwalonya, Nicolle, Nicolle & Zimbu, Mgombato: Digo-English-Swahili Dictionary (BTL / Digo Language and Literacy Project, 2004; e-version 2005)
